name: Object Voxelization by Filtering
definition: A voxelization technique that treats 3D scan conversion as a sampling process, using a low-pass filtering function to suppress aliasing (high frequencies above the Nyquist rate) before sampling the continuous object signal into a discrete voxel raster.
summary: Object Voxelization by Filtering converts continuous 3D objects into scalar-valued fuzzy voxels via low-pass filtering, avoiding the aliasing and normal estimation errors of binary methods.
